title: Explain Editorial triage and assignment planning decisions
description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As a section editor, I want a guide to nomination and desk-editor news judgment, so that I can understand outcomes and allocate reporting effort.

Acceptance behavior (planned, not executable or verified yet):
```gherkin
Feature: Explain Editorial triage and assignment planning decisions
  Scenario: Understand the triage workflow
    Given a candidate is nominated for one or several sections
    When I read the Editorial triage guide
    Then it distinguishes fast Jev/Cyclotron nomination from higher-capability LLM desk-editor judgment
    And it explains current guidance resolution, story overlap, evidence and attributed rationale
    And it documents attach, propose or create under policy, refer, hold and dismiss outcomes
    And it explains that agent decisions are not human training labels
    And undecided budget amounts, hard caps and concurrency remain explicit
```

Link the existing shared-context and Section-classifier milestones, not a copied stale policy or new engine. Keep implementation state and actual configuration capability truthful.
